hook_plan.narration: Stop scrolling! A hidden labor crisis threatens TSMC's 20-fab expansion, jeopardizing global chip supply!
hook_plan.image_description: A digital rendering of a partially constructed mega-fab with glowing blue lines, viewed through smart glasses. Red warning lights flash on a cybernetic eye reflection. Intense focus, dramatic lighting.

thumbnail_plan.image_description: Hyper-realistic 3D render of a futuristic semiconductor wafer with glowing circuit patterns, partially obscured by a holographic blueprint of a factory. Dramatic side lighting, 8k resolution, centered composition.
thumbnail_plan.reasoning: Highlights the core issue of TSMC's building challenges and the future of chip production, using a strong, technical visual of a wafer and a factory blueprint to attract investors and engineers.

title: TSMC's Fab Crisis & AI CAPEX: Market Implications

segments.text: TSMC plans 20 new fabs globally, but faces critical construction worker shortages. This directly impacts long-term wafer output goals.
segments.image_prompt: A partially constructed futuristic fab with robotic arms moving materials, an overlay of digital blueprints and a highlighted area showing a worker shortage icon. Cinematic lighting.

segments.text: This labor bottleneck could delay CAPEX deployment, creating new supply chain chokepoints. Samsung Electronics watches closely for market shifts.
segments.image_prompt: Complex digital supply chain network visualization, with red warning indicators on a bottleneck node representing labor shortage. Analytical data interface, dark background.

segments.text: Samsung and SK Hynix are now testing Chinese chip tools following the VEU policy expiration. This diversifies their supply chain risks.
segments.image_prompt: A close-up of a technician, eyes reflecting data on a screen showing a 'VEU Expired' notification next to schematic diagrams of various chip manufacturing tools, including some with Chinese characters. Intense focus, dramatic side lighting.

segments.text: Shifting to local Chinese equipment could lower costs but introduces new geopolitical dependencies. Engineers are evaluating performance carefully.
segments.image_prompt: A split screen: one side showing a lower-cost, domestically sourced chip tool; the other showing a complex geopolitical map with flashing trade routes. A serious, thoughtful expression on a cybernetic face with glowing iris.

segments.text: AI's intense demand fuels a CAPEX boom. Foreign media estimate TSMC has 22% upside, reflecting its critical role in GPU manufacturing.
segments.image_prompt: A holographic projection of stacked GPU chips, surrounded by rising CAPEX graphs and a 22% 'upside' indicator. Dynamic lighting, analytical interface, cyberpunk aesthetic.

segments.text: The HBM market's extreme demand is driving record CAPEX, impacting long-term chip valuation.
segments.image_prompt: A macro shot of HBM memory stacks glowing, with digital data streams illustrating extreme demand and rising valuation curves. Cyberpunk neon aesthetic, dramatic backlighting.
